resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. The second character-design direction is the measured axis. Put its named face geometry and proportions on the visible subject. Translate its silhouette and layers into large asymmetric garment shapes, and repeat its seam curves and closures as front-readable clothing details. Photorealistic adult editorial treatment: long vertical set divisions, narrow rectangular shadows, and clean upright edges. Use exactly two dominant colors across clothing, light, shadow, and backdrop, smooth tonal transitions and controlled satin sheen on lit surfaces, upward beams, rising forms, and restrained ceremonial glints, and hard separated silhouette and shadow edges with few controlled breaks. Place three empty tall light panels; put glossy satin on clothing and panels; raise three narrow light beams behind the figure; give shadows hard knife-cut boundaries. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: An adult character has a broad heroic silhouette with a strong upper body and grounded stance, a long adult face with high cheekbones, a narrow nose bridge, and calm eyes, and compact adult proportions with a shorter frame and fully mature facial structure. The design is unified by restrained geometric fastenings and repeated seam angles that support a clear hierarchy. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—frame literally from the complete crown through both feet, with generous visible background margin above the hairstyle and below both shoes.
